heading: Swift: public configuration in native Tac
body: Swift is native Tac on macOS and iOS. It is not a Yon endpoint language. Only the public tac configuration may enter client code. The build publishes client/manifest.json, including its tac member, at /manifest.webmanifest. Browser and native web surfaces can fetch it. Native services use a loader that they own, or public input. This short Swift service binds a public snapshot. It does not touch the private Yon configuration or .env. Tachyon does not assign fields automatically, and there is no Tac dependency container.
